npcs.talkLine: Ront grunts and jerks his chin at you. He has a plan, and it involves drow throats.
barks: Ront mutters something about orc blood and drow throats.

npcs.talkLine: Eldeth Feldrun catches your eye. She wants a word.
Derendil draws himself up. A prince of Nelrindenvane requires a word with you.
barks: Derendil reminds everyone, again, that he is a prince of Nelrindenvane.
Sarith stares at nothing and does not answer.

npcs.talkLine: Buppido waves you over, smiling. He has a little idea he would love to share.
barks: Buppido hums to himself, smiling too much.

npcs.talkLine: Jimjar wants to bet you something. Anything. Just come here.
barks: Jimjar offers odds on which of you the drow will feed to the spiders first.
The twins whisper to each other, then go quiet when you look over.
Turvy nudges Topsy and points at the gate.

npcs.talkLine: Shuushar opens his eyes. He would speak with you, when you are ready.
barks: Shuushar stands very still, breathing slowly, as calm as deep water.

npcs.talkLine: A soft haze of spores drifts your way. Stool wants to talk, in its way.
barks: Stool's cap sways. A faint, friendly haze of spores drifts your way.
